title: Njirimara ikpo okwu
requiredTextNote: Ụfọdụ mkpado ederede dị mkpa ma na-agbanye mgbe niile (egosiri ka agbanyụrụ).
featuresWarning: Ịgbanyụ nhọrọ ndị a nwere ike iwepụ ikike dị mkpa maka ide na nchịkwa.
largeSiteWarning: Saịtị a nwere ọtụtụ ibe. Imepụta ọkpụkpụ nwere ike were oge.
skeletonLargeSiteConfirm: Saịtị a nwere ibe {count}. Imepụta ọkpụkpụ nwere ike iwe oge ma mepụta faịlụ buru ibu. Gaa n'ihu?
addPageFeatureDescription: Na-ekwe ka emepụta ibe ọhụrụ site na ogwe elu, omume ndepụta isiokwu, na omume ọchụchọ iwu.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Na-ekwe ka ehichapụ ibe site n'omume ibe, omume ndepụta isiokwu, na usoro nchịkwa metụtara ya.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye ngwaọrụ usoro saịtị, gụnyere omume ndepụta isiokwu na ọrụ nchịkwa Usoro.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Na-egosi ohere Ntuziaka Ụdị na ngwaọrụ nchịkwa na ụzọ mkpirisi ọchụchọ iwu.
insightsFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye Akụkọ na nchịkwa na ọchụchọ iwu ka nlele nyocha na nghọta dị.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Na-achịkwa ngalaba Ntọala saịtị maka Nkọwa, Ngọngọ, na nhazi Ndezi.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye ngalaba ntọala Ọdịdị/Isiokwu na nchịkwa saịtị.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye profaịlụ odee na ntọala metadata odee na nchịkwa saịtị.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye ntọala njin ọchụchọ na nkwalite metadata na nchịkwa saịtị.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Na-egosi njikwa edezi metadata ibe dị ka aha, akara ngosi, ọnọdụ, mkpado, na mkpọchi.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Na-egosi nchọgharị ngọngọ ma na-ekwe ka etinye ngọngọ ọdịnaya ọhụrụ mgbe a na-edezi.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Na-egosi ngalaba Ngọngọ ama ama n'ime onye nhọrọ ngọngọ.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Na-egosi ngalaba Ngọngọ nso nso a n'ime onye nhọrọ ngọngọ.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Na-egosi maapụ ọdịnaya ibe/panel usoro mgbe a na-edezi ọdịnaya.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye nlele isi iyi HTML maka idezi akara ibe ozugbo.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye usoro ibulite faịlụ na ohere njikwa mgbasa ozi/faịlụ metụtara ya.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye njikọ mgbasa ozi n'ịntanetị na isi iyi ọchụchọ mgbasa ozi dị anya.
communityFeatureDescription: Na-agbanye ọnọdụ ọchụchọ iwu metụtara obodo na omume gbadoro ụkwụ n'ịkpọtụrụ obodo.
